messages:
matt: CI microbench failure on PR #5399 — kv_cache_warmup microbench is +12% over the gated threshold. artifact: https://ci.redwood/builds/5399/artifacts/kv_warm.json. anyone seen this pattern? :eyes:
ellie: Ugh. That PR touched kernel selection heuristics in runtime/kernel_selector. Starting a quick bisect on the change set now.
sam: I reran the microbench locally (3090) with cold vs warm cache. Cold-cache looks identical to baseline, warm-cache shows ~11% regression. Suspect interaction with KV cache warmup path.
jen: thanks @sam. can you paste the perf numbers and any flamegraph hotspots? which sequence length did you use? (seq_len=1024/2048?)
sam: seq_len=2048. perf gist below:
```
kv_cache_warm_microbench
baseline: 0.84 us/token
pr: 0.94 us/token (+11.9%)
p99: baseline 2.1ms -> pr 2.9ms
hotspots: runtime::kernel_selector::choose_kernel +31%
```
ellie: hmm. the kernel selector change prefers matmul_tiled for seq < 1024 to reduce mem stalls. maybe it flips selection during KV hot path incorrectly.
perf-bot: Auto-profile uploaded: s3://ci-artifacts/5399/profile-1798765432.html
matt: can someone run the microbench with REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH=0 to see if prefetch/pipelining interacts with the new kernel choices?
sam: running that now locally, will paste results shortly.
sam: update — with REDWOOD_KV_PREFETCH=0 the PR perf matches baseline within noise. So prefetch + new kernel heuristic appears to cause the regression.
jen: good find. options: revert heuristic, add a prefetch guard in kernel selector for KV paths, or tighten selection predicate. which is fastest to land?
ellie: I'll open a small revert PR for the heuristic so the release isn't blocked. also filing a follow-up to add an explicit test that exercises warm KV path in perf-suite.
matt: :thumbsup: please include perf unit for the warm KV case and mark threshold to avoid flakiness while followup lands. also add a short comment in the PR explaining the prefetch interaction.
ci-bot: Re-run triggered: https://ci.redwood/run/5399/retry (rerun queued)
sam: filing a perf issue with logs, flamegraphs and the env reproducer. will link in the revert PR.
jen: after revert lands we should run a full canary to be safe.
ellie: agree — targeting revert PR this afternoon.
matt: thanks all — good triage.
